concerns.text: Task T057 (VIF Analysis) is marked as incomplete/unchecked, yet it is the sole task covering the plan's explicit requirement for 'Variance Inflation Factor (VIF) for the covariates' to detect multicollinearity. Without this task, the statistical validity of the GLMM model (Plan: 'Statistical Rigor') and the reliability of the functional relationship (FR-005) cannot be verified.

Tasks T047 (Reproducibility Run), T049 (Data Hygiene Audit), and T051 (Final State Registry Update) are marked as incomplete. These are the only tasks covering Constitution Principles I (Reproducibility), III (Data Hygiene), and V (Versioning Discipline) regarding the final state of artifacts. Their absence means the project cannot satisfy the constitutional requirement that 'Every result... MUST be reproducible' and 'Every artifact... carries a content hash'.

Task T061 (Token Count Verification Script) is marked as incomplete. The Plan's 'Specific Implementation Tasks' section explicitly lists 'T-Tokenizer' and 'T-Verify-Oracle' as required tasks. While T007/T022 implement token counting, T061 is the only task providing the independent verification artifact required by the plan's own 'Token Counting' section to ensure the claim 'token usage is simulated using a standard tokenizer' is validated.

Task T062 (Data Consistency Check) is marked as incomplete. This is the sole task covering the plan's requirement to 'cross-reference data/raw/, data/processed/, and data/results/' to ensure no data is lost. Without this, the integrity of the pipeline's data flow (Plan: 'Data Hygiene') is unverified.

Tasks T063 (Memory Usage Profiling) and T064 (CPU Time Limiting) are marked as incomplete. These are the only tasks covering the Plan's 'Execution Environment & Resource Validation' phase, which is required to verify compliance with FR-007 (CPU-only, <7GB RAM) and the 6-hour runner limit. Without these, the resource constraints are not actively validated.
